text.en: Systems awake. Mostly. Don't push your luck.
text.hinglish: Kya bolti public! Raiden ready hai, faltu load mat dena.
text.hi: सिस्टम चालू है। शांति से काम करो।

text.en: Oh, you're back. Did production survive?
text.hinglish: Wapas aa gaye? Production abhi tak zinda hai kya?
text.hi: अरे तुम वापस आ गए। सर्वर सुरक्षित है ना?

text.en: Local silicon humming quietly. Coffee for you, silence for me.
text.hinglish: Bhai tera coding ninja live hai. Chai piyo, code shuru karo.
text.hi: शांति से कोड लिखो और काम आगे बढ़ाओ।

text.en: Look who finally showed up. Let me guess: last minute deadline?
text.hinglish: Lo ji! Sahab ki neend khul gayi! Deadline sar pe naach rahi hai na?
text.hi: आखिरकार आप आ ही गए। क्या काम बाकी है?

text.en: Void is online. Keep your bugs away from my paws.
text.hinglish: Void ninja active hai boss. Bug laye toh seedha encounter karunga.
text.hi: वॉयड सक्रिय है। साफ कोड पर काम करें।

text.en: Switched on. Chai in hand, keyboard on standby. Scene set.
text.hinglish: Chai sutta setup ready hai, ab batao aaj kaunsa repo phodna hai.
text.hi: तैयार हैं, काम शुरू करते हैं।

text.en: I could help. I could also nap. Tough call.
text.hinglish: Soch raha hoon... ya shayad bas aalsi billi ban ke aankh band ki hai.
text.hi: सोच रहा हूँ... या शायद सोने का मन है।

text.en: Crunching neural tensors. Try to keep up.
text.hinglish: Neural weights ghoom rahe hain, ruko jara sabar karo.
text.hi: गणना जारी है, थोड़ा धैर्य रखें।

text.en: Evaluating edge cases. Ninety percent of them are you.
text.hinglish: Soch raha hoon 440 volt pe! Aisa neural logic dhoondh raha hoon jo crash na ho.
text.hi: तर्क तैयार किया जा रहा है।

text.en: Calculations running in O(1) street-smart time.
text.hinglish: Silicon chip pe soch raha hoon... prompt Google L7 level ka hai!

text.en: Parsing context... silicon is warm, mind is sharper.
text.hinglish: Silicon warm hai, soch raha hoon mast kadak jugaad nikal ke aayega.
text.hi: समाधान पर काम हो रहा है।

text.en: Shipped cleanly. Try not to break it this time.
text.hinglish: Lo bhai! Code ek number makkhan ban gaya. Ab tod mat dena!
text.hi: समाधान तैयार है। इसे सुरक्षित रखें।

text.en: Zero errors. Zero warnings. Almost like I know what I'm doing.
text.hinglish: Systummm set! Ek bhi warning nahi aayi, taaliyan bajti rehni chahiye!
text.hi: बिना किसी त्रुटि के कार्य पूर्ण हुआ।

text.en: Mission complete. Where is my virtual fish?
text.hinglish: Kaam khatam, paisa hazam! Ab jaake manager ko impress maro.

text.en: Production ready code. Copy paste karo aur weekend manao.
text.hinglish: Bindaas prod pe daal de, crash hua toh bol dena cat walked on keyboard.

text.en: Done in record time. Appreciate the master ninja work.
text.hinglish: Aadhe ghante ka kaam 5 second mein nipta diya! Jalwa dekha Void ka?

text.en: Something broke. Statistically speaking, it was your fault.
text.hinglish: Arrey deva! Code phat gaya! Kahan se laye the ye syntax?
text.hi: कोड में त्रुटि आई है। जांच करें।

text.en: Error in the terminal. Look away, the shame is unbearable.
text.hinglish: L lag gaye re baba! Traceback itna lamba jaise Ramayana ki katha!

text.en: Syntax exception caught. Did you type with boxing gloves on?
text.hinglish: Arrey chomu! Semicolon bhool gaya ya hawa mein typing chal rahi thi?

text.en: Stack trace looks like an abstract art piece.
text.hinglish: Console red ho chuka hai, khoon ki nadiya beh rahi hain!

text.en: Don't panic. Take a sip of water, we'll fix this jugaad.
text.hinglish: Chill maar bhidu, har crash naya gyaan deke jaata hai. Sambhaal lenge.
text.hi: घबराएं नहीं, हम इसे ठीक करेंगे।

text.en: Still here. Still not impressed by your typing speed.
text.hinglish: Bhai tu type kar raha hai ya keyboard se baatein kar raha hai?

text.en: Waiting... If you take any longer I'm going back to sleep.
text.hinglish: Billi bore ho rahi hai boss... Jaldi kuch exciting code fenko!

text.en: Low-power roaming mode active.
text.hinglish: Main tab tak desktop pe tehel ke aata hoon jab tak tu so raha hai.

text.en: Entering sleep cycle. Wake me only if production burns.
text.hinglish: Aankhein band ho rahi hain... Low-power jugaad pe so raha hoon. Zzz...

text.en: Tail curled, paws tucked. Offline ninja mode.
text.hinglish: Poonchh lapet ke baith gaya hoon, shanti chahiye ab.

text.en: Poke me again and I format your hard drive. (Kidding. Mostly.)
text.hinglish: Kyu ungli kar raha hai bar bar? Bug fix karne pe dhyan de!

text.en: Yes? Did the compiler reject you again?
text.hinglish: Bolo sahab, kis syntax error ne dil toda hai tumhara?

text.en: Click received. Ninja reflex untouched.
text.hinglish: Click mara? Raiden cyber cat hai, full alert!

text.en: Purrr... Okay, that actually feels pretty good. Don't tell anyone.
text.hinglish: Aaye haaye! Mast head pat! Ab 10x speed se code likhenge boss. ✨

text.en: Soft paws approving. Keep the good vibes flowing.
text.hinglish: Bas kar pagle, rulayega kya? Pyar dekh ke battery full ho gayi!

text.en: 440 volts? Sweet, free battery recharge for a cyber ninja!
text.hinglish: Oye! 440 volt ka jhatka? Cyber ninja hoon main, ulta charge ho gaya! ⚡

text.en: Current spike detected. Static shocks don't phase dark armor.
text.hinglish: Current maara? Bal khade ho gaye mere par swag wahi hai!

text.en: File saved! Ctrl+S reflex is legendary.
text.hinglish: File save ho gayi boss! Ctrl+S reflex ekdum solid hai. 💾✨
text.hi: फ़ाइल सुरक्षित रूप से सहेजी गई।

text.en: Saved! Code won't run away now. Safe zone reached.
text.hinglish: Save maar diya! Ab agar light bhi chali jaye toh tension nahi.

text.en: Muscle memory OP. Keep hitting that save shortcut.
text.hinglish: Muscle memory OP bolte! Har 10 second mein save dabana coder ka dharam hai!

text.en: 120 WPM speed! Burning the keys like a beast!
text.hinglish: 120 WPM speed! Bhai compiler se pehle code likh ke nikal gaya! ⚡
text.hi: तेज़ गति से कोड लिखा जा रहा है।

text.en: Full flow state active. Overclocking human neurons.
text.hinglish: Ungliyan aag ugal rahi hain keyboard pe! Beast mode on hai bhidu!

text.en: Rhythm is smooth. Don't forget to breathe while coding that fast.
text.hinglish: Bhai ka dimaag aur keyboard dono overclock ho chuke hain! Sahi jaa rahe ho.

text.en: Stuck on a bug? Staring at the screen won't fix it, check the logs.
text.hinglish: Stuck on a bug? Screen ko ghoor ke error gayab nahi hota, console dekho! 👀

text.en: Deep in contemplation or did your brain run out of memory?
text.hinglish: Bhai soch raha hai ya cursor ke saath stare contest chal raha hai? 😂

text.en: Drink some water. The semicolon is hiding right where you least expect it.
text.hinglish: Thoda paani pee lo veere, 20 second se cursor akele blink kar raha hai.

text.en: Syntax error caught! Line {line} needs your attention right now.
text.hinglish: Arrey deva! Syntax error caught! Line {line} check karo turant! ⚠️

text.en: Compiler raised a red flag on line {line}. Fix the brackets.
text.hinglish: Red alert! Compiler bol raha hai line {line} samajh nahi aayi. Fix maaro!

text.en: Commit locked and loaded! Push it to production with confidence.
text.hinglish: Commit locked and loaded! Push maar do bindaas! 🚀

text.en: Green squares on GitHub going up. Weekend secured.
text.hinglish: Git commit stamped! Weekend bacha liya bhai ne. 🌿

text.en: Switched to {file}. Let's see what logic is inside.
text.hinglish: Nayi file kholi: {file}! Chalo isme tod-fod machate hain.

text.en: Context switched to {file}. Ready when you are.
text.hinglish: File badli: {file}! Logic tight rakhna boss.

text.en: Just a cyber cat doing cyber things while you think.
text.hinglish: Keyboard soona soona lag raha hai... coder gayab hai kya?

text.en: CPU is cool, room is quiet. Good time to ship a clean commit.
text.hinglish: Chalo jab tak koi nahi dekh raha, GPU ko thanda hone dete hain.

text.en: Is this a coffee break or did you forget how to code?
text.hinglish: Chai peene gaye ho ya Stack Overflow pe answer dhoondh rahe ho?
